name: from_raw
declaration: unsafe fn from_raw (ptr : * const T) -> Self
rules: For safety, ptr must have originated from a previous call to Weak::into_raw paired with this Weak::from_raw call.
For safety, ptr must still own its potential weak reference; pointers created by Weak::new own no weak reference and are nevertheless permitted.
For safety, ptr must point to a block of memory allocated by the global allocator.
It is permitted to call Weak::from_raw when the strong count is 0.
Weak::from_raw takes ownership of the weak reference represented by ptr without modifying the weak count, except that pointers created by Weak::new own nothing.
